title: Agreement outside refreshed indices
statement: For a list $l$ of integers, let its frame give the list entry at each index and give $0$ beyond the list. Let $xs$ be a list of indices and $l'$ another list. If refreshing $l$ at the indices in $xs$ using the frame of $l'$ produces a list whose frame equals the frame of $l'$, then the frame of $l'$ agrees with the frame of $l$ at every index outside $xs$.
hypotheses_covered: the frames of the refreshed list and l' are equal
